watches.name: JG6700-11 Ben Spies Limited Edition
watches.description: There's something inspiring about knowing that your watch is modeled after someone truly extraordinary. With the Jorg Gray JG6700-11 Ben Spies Limited Edition, you'll feel the mystique of a living legend every time you put on your timepiece. Modeled for Spies, one of the most storied motorcycle racers of our time, this watch is engineered for speed and functionality without sacrificing class and fashion. With a scratch-resistant mineral crystal lens, water resistance up to depths of 100 meters and a stainless steel case, you will feel confident heading into any situation the day throws at you with this watch on your wrist. Designed for optimum durability, the case of the watch is held across your lower arm by a comfortable, efficient and integrated rubber band. Beneath its lens, the watch reveals an intricate black carbon-fiber dial featuring a three-hand chronograph complication. The watch is then completed with a tachymeter and beautifully crafted checkered flag theme. Measuring 48 millimeters across and 13.7 millimeters in width, the watch can easily tuck away under any sleeve when not in use. The Jorg Gray JG6700-11 Ben Spies Limited Edition: There is no finish line. watches.name: JG2500-22
watches.description: Few sports capture the beauty and raw passion of human movement in the same way that soccer does. This is the energy we channeled into the design of the JG2500-22. One of our finest Limited Edition models, this watch was made in honor of Clint Dempsey, one of the greatest soccer players of his generation and the former captain of the U.S. National Soccer Team. Whether you're an athlete yourself or simply an avid fan of the sport, you won't find a timepiece that caters to your lifestyle more than this. The first thing you'll notice after putting on this watch is the immaculately styled black stainless steel case. Measuring 52 millimeters across and 15.4 millimeters in width, the eye is naturally drawn to the exterior of the watch. Brought together by an integrated black rubber band, the case holds a soccer timer capable of measuring two 45-minutes halves and 15 minutes of extra time. The face of the watch also bears the signature of Dempsey set below a beautiful ISA movement complication housed beneath a domed mineral crystal. The Jorg Gray JG2500-22: Change the game. watches.name: JG7800-22
watches.description: You can tell a lot about a man by what chronograph he wears. Whenever you put on the JG7800-22, you can rest assured that you'll be giving off the right impression. A watch that exudes character in every passing second, this timepiece is done in a black and bronze theme that will pair easily with outfits for everything from the board room to the deck of sailboat. From its perforated black leather band to its incredibly accurate Swiss Ronda movement, you'll find perfection in every detail of this watch from the moment you put it on. The case of this timepiece measures 13 millimeters in thickness and 45 millimeters across and holds in place a beautiful sapphire coated mineral crystal lens. The analog display is laid beautifully over three bronze dials set into the black face of the watch. A 31-day date indicator is nestled perfectly to the left of the hash mark indicating three o'clock and the casing is water resistant to depths of up to 100 meters. The Jorg Gray JG7800-22 - when first impressions count.
